annotations.title: The user's teams and their private lessons

description: Without team: the teams the user is in on UpFork (slug, role, how many lessons). With team: that team's lessons, short, the newest first (all states, unless state says otherwise), and how many of the day's are used; with id, one whole. A team's lessons are private to its members: use them in the user's own work, never quote them anywhere public. Needs the user signed in, with the "teams" permission.

id.description: A lesson's id or T- number, to read it whole.

state.description: proposed, published, dropped or all (the default).

team.description: The team, by slug; leave out to list the user's teams.

name: team_lessons

outputSchema.description: The user's teams, or one team's lessons (short, and one whole with id). Private to the team's members.

appliesTo.description: What it applies to: name@range entries and other: entries.

author.description: The member whose assistant proposed it.

check.description: The command or action, and the result that proves the fix.

id.description: Its id: give it to draft_team_lesson to change it while it's proposed, or to team_lessons to read it.

next.description: What to tell the user, or do next.

number.description: Its T- number once published in the team: get_lesson reads it, for the team's members only.

packages.description: The packages and versions it was written with.

page.description: Its page, for the team's members.

publicNumber.description: The public lesson the team's owner made of it, if they did.

rule.description: If you see X, do Y.

state.description: proposed (waiting for the team's owner), published (in the team: number is its T- number) or dropped.

warnings.description: What UpFork's checks warned of when it was saved.

lessons.description: Its lessons in the state asked, short, the newest first.

items.description: A team lesson, short: team_lessons with its id reads it whole.

author.description: The member whose assistant proposed it.

slug.description: Its name in addresses: give it as team to draft_team_lesson and team_lessons.
